functions.meaning: Always clear flag 0x20. In mode 2 at offset 0x08, select state 9 for selector 0 or -1 at offset 0x10, clearing selector -1 to zero, or state 5 for selector -2.
Write state 3 when the signed root selector differs from -2; otherwise write state 6 if the marker word or flag mask 0x2 is nonzero. Original game role and full data-object boundaries remain unknown.

Write state 3 when the signed gate differs from -2. Otherwise clear flag 0x20 and select state 23 or 5 by a nonzero or zero marker; when 0x20 is clear, clear flag 0x08 and write state 7 if that flag is set.
Clear the signed root selector, replace a negative selection with 3 and clear its associated word, then always write state 8.
When mode at 0x15C is 2 and selection at 0x164 is negative, nonzero extra at 0x16C selects state 17 and flag 0x40; zero extra selects state 14.
Write state 3 for a nonzero gate; otherwise write state 10 when flag mask 6 is nonzero, or state 25 when flag 0x200 is set.

Under mode 2 and a negative selection, choose states 12, 3, 19 or 16 from the extra/selector words, signed phase short and the signed sum threshold 475; preserve state when the measured guards reject an update.
Write state 3 for a nonzero signed root selector; otherwise write state 13 when flag mask 0x2 is nonzero. Original game role and full data-object boundaries remain unknown.

Write state 3 when the signed gate is nonzero. Otherwise clear flag 0x20 and select state 24 or 12 by a nonzero or zero marker; when 0x20 is clear, clear flag 0x10 and write state 14 if that flag is set.
Conditionally clear flag bits 4 and 2; handle flag 0x80 with state 21 or flag 0x100 with state 20 while setting 0x40, otherwise select state 3 or 1 from the measured selector and word 0x17C.

When mode at offset 0x15C is 2 and selection at 0x164 is negative, nonzero extra at 0x16C or word at 0x24 clears word 0x17C, sets state 21 and flags 0x440; otherwise write word 0x17C to 1 and state 1.
Write state 3 when the signed root selector differs from -2; otherwise, only when flag mask 0x20 is set, clear it and write state 5. Original game role and full data-object boundaries remain unknown.
Write state 3 when the signed root selector is nonzero; otherwise, only when flag mask 0x20 is set, clear it and write state 12. Original game role and full data-object boundaries remain unknown.
